name: Otto AI x402 — Market Intelligence, DeFi & Trading
instructions_text: Otto AI's autonomous agent swarm sells pay-per-call services, settled in USDC on Base on every endpoint (some paths also quote Solana; the live 402's accepts[] is authoritative — Permit2/upto needs a one-time USDC allowance). Capability tags: Market & Token Intelligence (news + recaps, KOL sentiment, token analysis/price/fundamentals/security/score, trending, top holders, tokenized-stock movers), DeFi & Markets Data (TVL/yields, stablecoin peg-watch, market-risk composite, protocol revenue, DEX pool search + one-hour Uniswap APR, Polymarket odds, funding rates, TradFi macro, SEC Form 4/13F + equity smart-money), Web & Domain Intelligence (DNS, WHOIS, domain age/report, web-search/answer/extract/links/json-extract), Real-World Data (FX rates, weather), AI Creative & Tools (image/video generation, llm-research, tx-explainer), Portfolio & Accounts (wallet and position reads for the paying address), plus meta-intelligence (router ranks the best x402 services for a task, $0.001) and feedback (money-back guarantee; needs the original payment tx hash from X-Payment-Receipt). Fund-moving routes (swap, bridge, deposit, withdraw) and the full-auto spending router are deliberately NOT exposed by this server. Published prices are per call from $0.001; a route's live challenge outranks any published table, and every settled call returns a signed receipt in PAYMENT-RESPONSE.
